description: Free, read-only. Fetch a public http(s) URL and return its body as plain text: script, style, nav, header, footer and aside removed, tags stripped, entities decoded, whitespace collapsed. Median 98% fewer tokens than raw HTML. Follows up to 5 redirects, 10 s timeout; private and local hosts are rejected and non-2xx responses error with the HTTP status. Text past maxChars is cut and ends with '[Truncated at N chars]': raise maxChars (max 32000) or use fetch_html for everything. Runs no JavaScript: a client-side-rendered SPA or a bot/login wall yields almost no text, so the call errors instead of returning an empty shell and names the fix (fetch_rendered, paid, runs a browser; screenshot_url; or headers for auth). For title/OG/JSON-LD only use fetch_metadata; for Markdown with links use html_to_markdown.

headers.description: Headers to forward for pages behind login: Authorization, Cookie, X-API-Key only. Dropped if a redirect leaves the original host.

maxChars.description: Characters of text to return. Default 8000, max 32000 (higher values are clamped). Truncated output ends with a '[Truncated at N chars]' marker.

url.description: Public http:// or https:// URL. Local and private hosts are rejected.

name: fetch_extract
title: Fetch page as clean text
